title: The exercise rest picker is never checked on screen
what: Phone tests only tap a rest chip by name and see the sheet close. No test reads the sheet's title, which chip is selected, the Custom minute and second boxes, the 'Pick a rest from 0:05 to 10:00.' line, or the line shown when the phone cannot keep the choice. An imported 7:00 rest showing as the selected Custom chip is never tried.
expected: A test opens the rest picker from an exercise, sees the selected chip, types a custom length, tries a length out of range and a failed save, and sees the right words each time.
fix_line: Add one phone flow for the exercise rest picker: selected chip, Custom, out of range, failed save.

title: The rest bar's plus 15 and minus 15 buttons and 'Turn on' are never pressed in a test
what: Phone tests see the rest bar and press Skip, but never press +15 or -15 and read the clock, never take a rest down to zero, never press the 'Turn on' line when alerts are off, and never check there is no bar before the first tick.
expected: A test presses +15 and -15 and sees the clock move by 15 seconds, takes a short rest to zero and sees the bar go quietly, and presses Turn on to reach the phone's settings.
fix_line: Extend the rest bar phone flow to press +15, -15 and Turn on and read the results.

title: The 'Keep it?' question is never required on screen and Fix is never tested
what: The phone flow that types 300 kg taps Keep only if it happens to show, so the test passes even when the question never appears. No test presses Fix to untick the set, end its rest and put the cursor back in the weight box, or checks the question is not asked again for a normal weight. The 'Add reps first' row line and its gentle shake are checked only as words, never on screen.
expected: A test types a far-too-heavy weight, must see the question, presses Fix and sees the set unticked with no rest running; another ticks an empty row and sees the 'Add reps first' line.
fix_line: Make the Keep step required in the 300 kg flow and add a Fix step after it.

title: Warm-up and Failure set types are never chosen in a test
what: Phone tests only pick 'Drop set' and 'Remove set' from the set type sheet. No test picks Warm-up or Failure and sees the row read W or F, turns a warm-up back into a normal set, or closes the sheet without choosing and sees nothing change.
expected: A test picks each set type, sees the row mark change and the working-set count follow, and backs out once to see the set unchanged.
fix_line: Add Warm-up, Failure, back to Normal and a back-out to the existing drop set flow.

title: The workout recap's odd cases are never tested
what: No test checks the recap of a past workout in History (its tiles and open Exercises fold), the 'Log your body weight so pull-ups and dips count' line, a workout with no working sets, or the recap after a set was removed from a saved workout.
expected: Tests show the recap for a past workout, a pull-up workout with no body weight, an empty workout and an edited workout, and check the tiles, folds and line each time.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the recap's past, empty, no-body-weight and edited cases.

title: When sharing fails or is cancelled, no test checks what the member sees
what: Sharing a workout picture, a workout as text and a routine each has its own message for a phone with no share app, a failure, or a picture that takes too long, and each must work again after the member cancels. No test reaches any of these messages or tries sharing twice after a cancel.
expected: Tests make each share fail and see its message, and cancel the share list then share again with success.
fix_line: Add small tests that make the share step fail or cancel for picture, text and routine.

title: Parts of bringing routines in are never tested on screen
what: No test brings routines in from a Strong import, opens a single Hevy routine link and its 'to which folder?' screen, sees the disabled 'Tick a routine' button, closes the steps with nothing saved, or goes back from check screen 2 to 1 and sees the ticks kept.
expected: Phone or screen tests cover a Strong import, a single routine link, the nothing-ticked button and Back between check screens.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the routine steps for Strong, a single link, nothing ticked and Back.

title: The sleep and protein line on the finish screen is never shown in a test
what: The rules behind the line are well tested as data, but no test shows the finish screen with the sleep line or a protein tip, and none checks that the screen drawing again keeps the same line instead of counting a second tip as shown.
expected: A test shows the finish screen after a lighter workout with a short night and with a tip due, and draws it twice to see one tip counted.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the finish line: sleep, tip, and a second draw.

title: Timed, distance and target rows of a workout are barely tested
what: A phone test starts a plank's hold timer, but no test checks a typed time reads 1:30, a treadmill row shows no weight box and no '0 kg', or the target's 'i' stops pulsing and stays still with Reduce motion on.
expected: Tests tick a timed and a distance row and read them back, and check the target 'i' pulse stops and is off with Reduce motion.
fix_line: Add asserts to the existing all-kinds phone flow for the time, distance and target rows.
